source_title: Constellation-Level Power Allocation for LEO Space-Based Solar Power
limitations: Simulation preprint rather than flight demonstration.
Reported outcomes depend on declared constellation, propagation, coupling, atmospheric, battery, and greedy-policy assumptions.
Earth-facing microwave delivery is not identical to SNS optical relay operation.
fact_summary: A 20-satellite LEO SBSP simulation modeled eclipse, microwave coupling, atmosphere, and batteries; two of eight ground stations received no service under the greedy allocation policy.
inference_summary: SNS power-network evaluation must report starvation and service distribution, not only aggregate or peak delivered power.
speculation_summary: Fairness-aware allocation may sacrifice peak throughput while making a heterogeneous relay network operationally more credible.
